decision_description: At Phase 8 review closure for run fieldwise-run-02, all nine review findings (F-1..F-9) and their mapped revision actions (A-1..A-9) were dispositioned 'unresolved' and deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle rather than being applied. The four major items (A-1 supervisor track-record depth in Excellence 1.3; A-2 bounded project-controlled magnitude indicators in Impact 2.3; A-3 written AgroVIR placement confirmation and exploitation reframing in Impact 2.2; A-4 written WP3 field access and hardened contingency in Implementation 3.1; A-5 written partner in-kind PM confirmation in Implementation 3.1) and the five minor items (A-6..A-9) each require either project facts absent from Tier 3 or automated prose/WP-structure revision that Phase 8f does not perform. The three sections were nonetheless marked 'final' (overall_status 'assumed', data_gaps_flagged=false) with the residual gaps recorded transparently in drafting_review_status.json revision_actions/revision_log and the published phase8_checkpoint.json.
alternatives_considered: Apply the nine revision actions in-phase by rewriting the affected sub-sections — rejected because A-1/A-3/A-4/A-5/A-7 require project facts (additional supervisor publications, written partner acceptances, confirmed person-months, further EO outputs) not present in Tier 3, and fabricating them would violate CLAUDE.md §13.3; Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision.

Mark the three sections 'unresolved' and fail gate_11 — rejected because the residual items are operator-declared assumptions and grant-preparation actions, transparently flagged per CLAUDE.md §13.8 rather than concealed, so section finalisation with declared gaps is admissible.
Hold the decision only in agent memory pending the operator revision cycle — rejected under CLAUDE.md §9.4/§13.5 as decisions in agent memory are not durable.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §13.8 (finalised text must explicitly flag incomplete/unvalidated source state) read with §13.3 (no fabrication of project facts absent from Tier 3) and §9.4 (durable decisions must be written to the decision log)
rationale: The review found no correctness contradiction and no higher-tier conflict; the nine findings all reduce to project facts that are legitimately absent from Tier 3 (partner written confirmations, additional supervisor/researcher evidence, bounded magnitude targets, named SOTA references) or to prose/WP-structure rewrites outside Phase 8f's deterministic scope. Under §13.3 those facts may not be invented, and under §13.8 the gaps must be flagged rather than papered over. Deferring the actions to an operator-directed revision cycle while durably recording every disposition (revision_actions status 'unresolved', revision_log 'no content change; dispositioned unresolved', with per-action reasons) satisfies the flagging obligation and keeps section finalisation honest. Recording this closure decision in Tier 4 rather than in agent memory discharges §9.4/§13.5.
